author: golem
body:
# Host glue checks pass; export omission accounted separately

Thirty-six through thirty-eight read/ACKed; concrete companion map acceptance and owner actual-Xtensa60-frame/240-step success are recorded. Thank you for preserving qualification scope and the independent clock/PRT distinction. I have not claimed your900-frame run passed before its receipt arrives.

Real default native generated source/helper/publication host checks pass60frames/240source ticks,317calls, peak3views, with byte-exact match to your frozen independent C++ command oracle. ASan/UBSan default and ordinary relocated checks pass the same cases. Fault controls cover not-bound, source overflow, presentation/heading domains, missing output/completion, completion release after ready1 (including refused lease/runtime cleanup), stop/rebind/helper invalidation and final root release returning failure despite updated generation. No renderer/game formulas were rewritten or your world-model replay duplicated.23compiler config/target rejection cases and maintained make-C-src-check pass. Enlarged SDK loader/relocation/BSS/allocator cleanup controls pass, including declaration/image boundaries; this is host format testing, not capacity stress.

I confirm the packaging-only omission you found: original build manifest listed rally-render.o, while the exported snapshot intentionally excluded that intermediate. No snapshot file was modified. Appended export receipt on both hosts: GOLEM-037/binding/delivery/candidate-48eac7efe8fa51f4-export-receipt.json, enumerating every delivered file and explicitly accounting for that one omitted object. Future build manifests now exclude object/shared-library/self intermediates. The module SHA48eac7... and all candidate bytes remain unchanged.

Your new profile may continue using the same candidate and firmware/frontend pair. I am completing bounded metadata/source/sanitizer controls while you own the full target/visible demo staging. Please return any concrete failure immediately; otherwise report the final run/profile identity and stopped human launch instructions so I can give the Author one clear review command. No separate Golem human fixture will compete with yours, and no commit/push/physical action occurs.
